verdict.rationale: Anytype's own infrastructure syncs and backs up data automatically in the background (anytype-docs-42), across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android (anytype-docs-54). The docs state that not even Anytype can see your content (anytype-docs-31, anytype-docs-43), with data kept in an encrypted Vault tied to a 12-word key (anytype-docs-44, anytype-docs-15), and users independently report that sync between devices works well (anytype-comm-3, anytype-comm-8, anytype-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent verification or audit of the vendor-can't-read encryption claim, and detailed documentation of how encryption works on the sync node (the team notes local indexes are not yet encrypted).
